lines.zh: 我踩着源石碎屑往前走。
lines.en: I walk over the originium fragments.
Every step of mine presses deep.

lines.zh: 橙色的光从我背上一路亮。
lines.en: Orange light runs along my back.
I circle along the vein.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石上留下痕。
lines.en: My claws leave marks on the stone.

lines.zh: 我低头走，眼睛没离开前方。
lines.en: I walk head low, eyes ahead.

lines.zh: 晶体随着呼吸一起一伏。
lines.en: The crystals rise and fall as I breathe.
My tail sweeps the rubble aside.

lines.zh: 我从矿石堆后面绕出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the ore heap.
This stretch of vein is mine to guard.

lines.zh: 我走一步，地面就裂一条缝。
lines.en: Each step cracks the ground.
I am in no hurry; the stone will wait.

lines.zh: 我站在那里，像一座矿塔。
lines.en: I stand like a tower of ore.
The originium hums inside me.
I lower my head and sniff the rubble.
The smell here is sharp.
I stand still, breathing heavily.
The crystal on my back flares once.
I count the ore chunks around me.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖僵住了，又松开。
lines.en: My knee locks, then releases.
Something moves under the ground.

lines.zh: 我不怕被挖，我怕被忘记。
lines.en: I do not fear being mined; I fear being forgotten.
You have originium dust on you.
I smell iron and sweat.
You have been mining here.
I lower my head and look at you a long time.

lines.zh: 你袖口的源石粉，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the originium dust on your sleeve.
You stand too close to the vein.
Your breathing is uneven.

lines.zh: 我背上的光映着你的脸。
lines.en: The light from my back falls on your face.
Do not touch those crystals.
You cut into my stone hide.
Chips fall from my shoulder.
I step back and the ground rings.
It hurts, but this body is made of ore.
A heavy blow, well placed.

lines.zh: 我闷哼，粉末从嘴里出来。
lines.en: I grunt and powder comes from my mouth.
That drove me half to my knees.
I raise a hand over my chest.
You have a few blows left in you.

lines.zh: 那种甜腻的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know that cloying smell.
Originium, or meat?
I shift one step that way.
Don't hold it high; lower it.
I eat ore, and I eat iron.
I open my mouth and breath hisses through my teeth.
You are shaking; I cannot aim.
That is not enough for me.
I pin it down and chew slowly.
You hit my leg like hitting ore.
I hold; you fall back.
The bump throws up crystal dust.
Your shoulder strikes my crystal.
I do not move; the ground rings.
We collide heavily.

lines.zh: 我抬手把你拨开，源石尘都扬了。
lines.en: I swat you aside; Originium dust rises.
Don't press against me; the crystal cuts.
We each take a step back.
You are dusted with powder now.

lines.zh: 源石生物没有成对的说法。
lines.en: Originium creatures do not pair.
I grew out of the vein.
Ask that and the ore would laugh.
I only guard the vein.
I lower my head and say nothing.
My blood is made of stone.
There is no second me here.
Move aside; I must go watch the vein.
I turn and my crystal scrapes the ground.
Leave that sentence in the soil.
I lower my head and take the ore.
I hold it in my claws.
It burned once in my mouth.
I pile it by the vein.
This piece is the wrong colour.
I press it and grind it down.
Keep it; don't spill it.

lines.zh: 这一身黑，源石结在里面。
lines.en: This black hide has Originium set inside.
You snapped the rubble.
Down the vein, I have picked you out.
You are standing on the vein.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，背上的光亮了。
lines.en: I raise my head and the crystal flares.

lines.zh: 你身上有源石粉的味道。
lines.en: You smell of originium dust.
The ore here is mine.
I lift a foot and rubble rolls.

lines.zh: 你的镐举到一半就停了。
lines.en: Your pick stopped halfway up.
Walk back and I will slow.
Do not bring light into the vein.

lines.zh: 我想看你的脚印能延伸多远。
lines.en: I want to see how far your prints run.

lines.zh: 这一带的土很松，你跑不快。
lines.en: The soil is loose here; you cannot run fast.
I come after you step by step.
You cross the pit and its walls give way.
My crystals are shaking.
The ground is full of my footprints.
I stop and listen to your steps.
You are hiding behind the ore.
I go around by the ore heap.
Run more and the originium will wake.

lines.zh: 我数着你一口气的长度。
lines.en: I count the length of each breath you take.
Dust is starting to fill your footprints.
This path ends at the ore wall.
I have quickened my pace.
I am nearly on you.
I lift a claw to chest height.
The hum of my crystals grows nearer.
At last you have stopped.
Good; now turn around.
I bring a claw down.

lines.zh: 这一下带着石头的重量。
lines.en: That came with the weight of stone.
The blow drives you into the ore wall.
There is powder on my claws.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的晶体，崩了一块。
lines.en: You strike my crystal and a shard breaks.
I raise my hand for another swipe.
You fall back; I press forward.
I bite down; my teeth are blunt.
You break free; I am not hurried.
I raise the other hand.
You are on your knees, panting.
I set my foot on the soil beside you.
Do you still have strength?

lines.zh: 那就再挨一下矿的力气。
lines.en: Then take the weight of ore again.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把碎石砸过去。
lines.en: I scoop up rubble and hurl it.

lines.zh: 你躲开了，矿渣落了一地。
lines.en: You dodge and slag rains down.
I shoulder you aside.
You cut my leg and I give ground.

lines.zh: 我从矿脉的裂口里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a crack in the vein.
The crystal's glow comes first.
The ore here has just woken.
I crush a layer of stone.
The air is full of ore dust.
I lift my head and find the way out.
Half a chunk of ore is still in my back.
There is light; a torch.
I begin walking that way.

lines.zh: 地下的东西跟着我动了。
lines.en: What is below moves with me.
I push up off my knee.
Fire bakes my crystal red.

lines.zh: 我从坑壁摔下，砸出一个窝。
lines.en: I fall from the pit wall and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水渗进石头缝里，又冷又重。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams, cold and heavy.
The blast blows off half my shoulder.
The arrowhead snaps against my hide.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的晶体。
lines.en: That force works into my crystal.
Without ore my glow dims.

lines.zh: 雷劈开我的背，晶片四飞。
lines.en: Lightning splits my back and shards fly.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，粉在身后散开。
lines.en: I fall, powder scattering behind me.
